name: How do I choose the right molding size and profile for my home?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right molding size and profile for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Select your trim profile based on your ceiling height, door casing style, and overall home architecture. Rooms with eight-foot ceilings generally look best with crown moldings between three and five inches tall, as larger pieces can make low ceilings feel crowded. Rooms with ten-foot or vaulted ceilings can accommodate five- to seven-inch profiles or multi-layered build-ups. It is also important to match baseboard thickness to door casing; your baseboards should not extend past the face of your door trim. Abraham Becerra reviews your existing interior openings and framing layout during the planning walk-through to prevent awkward profile mismatches.
acceptedAnswer.description: Base the profile on your ceiling height and door casing thickness. Lower ceilings suit three- to five-inch profiles, while tall ceilings accommodate wider, multi-piece moldings.
